name: Micron Idaho Fab 2, Boise

parties.name: U.S. Department of Commerce
parties.note: The June 2025 amendment of Micron's CHIPS Act agreements brought this fab under the existing award.

summary: A second leading-edge DRAM fab on Micron's Boise campus, announced in June 2025 as part of an expanded U.S. investment plan and placed under the company's existing CHIPS Act funding. Micron says construction began in 2026 and expects initial wafer output by late calendar 2028, ahead of the first New York fab.

metrics.note: CHIPS Act direct funding agreements signed in December 2024 for one Boise fab and two Clay, New York fabs; amended in June 2025 to add the second Boise fab without raising the total.
Per-fab cleanroom stated on the undated federal award page for each Idaho fab.

milestones.note: Initial wafer output expected by late calendar 2028.

notes: Micron has said that once this fab is complete it intends to bring HBM advanced packaging to the United States; no site or amount for that step is recorded here.

registry_records.note: The award covers two high-volume fabs at Boise together.
